request.initial_prompt: [5] For instance, Contrast or Contrariety is also a connexion among Ideas: but it may, perhaps, be considered as a mixture of _Causation_ and _Resemblance_. Where two objects are contrary, the one destroys the other; that is, the cause of its annihilation, and the idea of the annihilation of an object, implies the idea of its former existence.

raw_segments.text: For instance, Contrast or Contrariety is also a connexion among Ideas. But it may, perhaps, be considered as a mixture of causation and resemblance.
Where two objects are contrary, the one destroys the other. That is, the cause of its annihilation, and the idea of the annihilation of an object, implies the idea of its former existence.
